```diff
+ import { createI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
+ import zhCN from '../locales/zh-CN'
+ import enUS from '../locales/en-US'
+ 
+ const i18n = createI18n({
+   legacy: false,
+   locale: localStorage.getItem('language') || 'zh-CN',
+   fallbackLocale: 'en-US',
+   messages: {
+     'zh-CN': zhCN,
+     'en-US': enUS
+   }
+ })
+ 
+ export default i18n 
```

```diff
+ import { createRouter, createWebHistory } from 'vue-router'
+

+           path: 'xml',

+           component: () => import('../views/format/XmlFormat.vue')
+         },

+       ]
+     },
+     {
+       path: '/encrypt',
+       name: 'Encrypt',
+       component: () => import('../views/encrypt/Index.vue')

+       name: 'Convert',
+       component: () => import('../views/convert/Index.vue')
+     },
+     {
+       path: '/image',
+       name: 'Image',
+       component: () => import('../views/image/Index.vue')
+     },
+     {
+       path: '/text',
+       name: 'Text',
+       component: () => import('../views/text/Index.vue')
+     },
+     {
+       path: '/other',
+       name: 'Other',
+       component: () => import('../views/other/Index.vue')
+     }
+   ]
+ })

+ export default router
```

让我们创建一个基本的格式化工具组件作为示例：


---

```diff
- 
+ <template>
+   <div class="json-formatter">
+     <n-card :title="t('format.json')">
+       <n-input
+         v-model:value="input"
+         type="textarea"
+         :autosize="{ minRows: 10 }"
+         :placeholder="t('format.jsonPlaceholder')"
+       />
+       <div class="button-group">
+         <n-button @click="formatJson" type="primary">
+           {{ t('common.format') }}
+         </n-button>
+         <n-button @click="compressJson">
+           {{ t('common.compress') }}
+         </n-button>
+         <n-button @click="copyToClipboard">
+           {{ t('common.copy') }}
+         </n-button>
+         <n-button @click="escapeJson">
+           {{ t('common.escape') }}
+         </n-button>
+         <n-button @click="unescapeJson">
+           {{ t('common.unescape') }}
+         </n-button>
+       </div>
+       <n-alert
+         v-if="error"
+         type="error"
+         :title="t('common.error')"
+         :content="error"
+       />
+     </n-card>
+   </div>
+ </template>
+ 
+ <script setup lang="ts">
+ import { ref } from 'vue'
+ import { useI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
+ import { NCard, NInput, NButton, NAlert } from 'naive-ui'
+ import { useMessage } from 'naive-ui'
+ 
+ const { t } = useI18n()
+ const message = useMessage()
+ 
+ const input = ref('')
+ const error = ref('')
+ 
+ const formatJson = () => {
+   try {
+     const parsed = JSON.parse(input.value)
+     input.value = JSON.stringify(parsed, null, 2)
+     error.value = ''
+   } catch (e) {
+     error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid JSON'
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const compressJson = () => {
+   try {
+     const parsed = JSON.parse(input.value)
+     input.value = JSON.stringify(parsed)
+     error.value = ''
+   } catch (e) {
+     error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid JSON'
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const copyToClipboard = async () => {
+   try {
+     await navigator.clipboard.writeText(input.value)
+     message.success(t('common.copySuccess'))
+   } catch (e) {
+     message.error(t('common.copyFailed'))
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const escapeJson = () => {
+   try {
+     input.value = JSON.stringify(input.value)
+     error.value = ''
+   } catch (e) {
+     error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid JSON'
+   }
+ }
+ 
+ const unescapeJson = () => {
+   try {
+     input.value = JSON.parse(input.value)
+     error.value = ''
+   } catch (e) {
+     error.value = e instanceof Error ? e.message : 'Invalid JSON'
+   }
+ }
+ </script>
+ 
+ <style scoped>
+ .json-formatter {
+   max-width: 1200px;
+   margin: 0 auto;
+   padding: 20px;
+ }
+ 
+ .button-group {
+   margin-top: 16px;
+   display: flex;
+   gap: 8px;
+ }
+ </style> 
```
